name: repeaty
description: Flashcards and spaced repetition for the browser, desktop, and self-hosted accounts.

scripts.build: npm run typecheck && vite build && node scripts/check-static-build.mjs
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run test && npm run test:e2e
scripts.build:server: npm run typecheck && vite build --mode server
scripts.test:e2e:server: npm run build && npm run build:server && playwright test --config playwright.server.config.ts
scripts.check:server: node scripts/export-server-schema.mjs --check && vitest run --mode server src/plugins/plugins.test.ts && cargo fmt --manifest-path server/Cargo.toml --check && cargo clippy --manifest-path server/Cargo.toml --locked --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo test --manifest-path server/Cargo.toml --locked && npm run test:e2e:server
scripts.build:desktop: npm run typecheck && vite build --mode desktop
scripts.test:e2e:desktop: npm run build:desktop && playwright test --config playwright.desktop.config.ts
